cases.title: Standard multi-language repo scan with default threshold
cases.user_request: Run a method brevity audit on this repository using the default 30-line threshold. Show me the top 20 longest methods.

notes: Repository contains TypeScript, Python, and Go source files.
Some methods are intentionally long (50-100+ lines) for test purposes.
The vendor/ and node_modules/ directories should be excluded by default.
available_artifacts: File system access for line count verification

artifact_requirements: Markdown report with a findings table sorted by line count descending
Each finding includes method name, file:line range, line count, and language
Summary section with total methods scanned, count over threshold, and distribution
static_checks: Findings table is present and non-empty
Every file path in findings exists in the repository
No finding has a line count of 30 or fewer
Findings are sorted by line count descending
review_questions: Are the reported line counts accurate to within 2 lines of the actual method length?
Does the summary accurately reflect the total number of methods scanned and the distribution of lengths?

cases.title: Custom threshold changes reported findings
cases.user_request: Run a method brevity audit with a threshold of 50 lines instead of the default 30. Only show methods longer than 50 lines.

notes: The repository has methods ranging from 10 to 150+ lines.
Raising the threshold to 50 should eliminate many findings that appear at the default 30-line threshold.

artifact_requirements: No findings for methods of 50 lines or fewer
Summary reflects the 50-line threshold, not the default
static_checks: No finding has a line count of 50 or fewer
Distribution buckets are relative to the 50-line threshold
review_questions: Did the agent correctly apply the 50-line threshold rather than the default 30?
Are methods between 30-50 lines correctly excluded from findings?

cases.title: Excluded directories are not scanned
cases.user_request: Run a method brevity audit but exclude the test/ and scripts/ directories in addition to the default exclusions. Use the default 30-line threshold.

notes: The test/ directory contains intentionally long test helper methods.
The scripts/ directory contains long shell scripts.
Both should be excluded from the scan per user request.

artifact_requirements: Markdown report with no findings from test/ or scripts/ directories
Default exclusions (vendor/, node_modules/, etc.) are also applied
static_checks: No finding references a file path under test/ or scripts/
No finding references a file path under vendor/ or node_modules/
Report header or notes mention the exclusion list
review_questions: Does the report correctly exclude all files under test/ and scripts/?
Are the default exclusion directories also properly excluded?
